scope.flow: RiskEngine.twapEMA() computes TWAP tick from OraclePack.getEMAs() and it is consumed by PanopticPool.getTWAP()/dispatchFrom() for staleness, solvency, and liquidation pricing
scope.environment: Solidity smart contract protocol (RiskEngine, OraclePack, PanopticPool)

statements.text: OraclePack.getEMAs() returns a tuple ordered spotEMA (index 0), fastEMA (index 1), slowEMA (index 2), eonsEMA (index 3), medianTick (index 4).
The TWAP tick computed by RiskEngine.twapEMA() is consumed by the protocol via PanopticPool.getTWAP() and used in dispatchFrom() for liquidations, force exercises, and settlements.
RiskEngine.twapEMA() unpacks the getEMAs() tuple positionally, assigning eonsEMA <- spotEMA, slowEMA <- fastEMA, fastEMA <- slowEMA.
RiskEngine.twapEMA() computes the TWAP tick as (6 * slow + 3 * fast + spot) / 10 instead of the intended 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons.
Incorrect positional tuple unpacking of OraclePack.getEMAs() in RiskEngine.twapEMA() causes the wrong TWAP tick, inconsistent with RiskEngine.isSafeMode() which unpacks in the correct order.

The mathematically different TWAP can cause false positives/negatives in StaleOracle() checks, potentially allowing operations when the intended TWAP would block them, or blocking operations when the intended TWAP would allow them.
Incorrect solvency classification can occur at the TWAP checkpoint because one of the four price points in the solvency grid is wrong.
Incorrect liquidation bonus / conversion pricing inputs can occur because getLiquidationBonus is fed sqrtRatioAtTick(twapTick) with the wrong TWAP tick.

RiskEngine.twapEMA() should compute the intended TWAP tick 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons, consistent with the system's own interpretation of getEMAs(), so that staleness, solvency, and liquidation pricing use the intended TWAP.

ambiguities: Report does not state a concrete triggering transaction or observed on-chain incident; impacts are described as potential.
No actor/authorization conditions are specified; the flaw is in internal computation, not caller-gated access.
Exact numeric TWAP values before/after are not given, only the formula mismatch.
